turbulence_model.title: Turbulence model
turbulence_model.description: Which turbulence closure the solver uses. k-omega SST is the general-purpose default and handles walls at any y+. Spalart-Allmaras solves one equation and suits flow around wings and bodies in a freestream; it also handles walls at any y+. k-epsilon, realizable k-epsilon and the Reynolds-stress models (LRR, SSG) use high-Re wall functions (y+ above about 30); realizable k-epsilon copes better than k-epsilon with separation and swirl. Reynolds-stress models suit strong swirl but may need a converged k-epsilon run first. Laminar solves no turbulence at all.

ref_speed.title: Reference speed
ref_speed.description: The free-stream speed U∞ coefficients divide by. Blank uses the inlet's speed.

ref_pressure.title: Reference pressure
ref_pressure.description: The free-stream gauge pressure p∞ the pressure coefficient subtracts. Blank is 0 Pa.

ref_area.title: Reference area
ref_area.description: The area force coefficients divide by (a frontal or wing area). No coefficients without it.

ref_length.title: Reference length
ref_length.description: The length the moment coefficient divides by (a chord). No moment coefficient without it.

ref_cofr.title: Centre of rotation
ref_cofr.description: The point moments are taken about. Blank is the origin.

ref_drag_dir.title: Drag direction
ref_drag_dir.description: The direction drag is measured along. Blank uses the inlet's flow direction, else +X.

ref_lift_dir.title: Lift direction
ref_lift_dir.description: The direction lift is measured along, at right angles to drag. Blank is +Z (+Y when drag runs along Z).

initial_flow.title: Starting flow
initial_flow.description: The velocity everywhere inside the domain when the solve starts. Still starts from rest. From the inlet starts the whole domain moving at the inlet's speed, along its vector or straight in through its faces (the fastest velocity inlet's speed and the largest one's direction), or at the freestream's velocity when there is no velocity inlet; with neither it starts from rest. Custom uses the components below.

potential_flow.title: Initialise with potential flow
potential_flow.description: Runs potentialFoam before the solver: a quick inviscid flow that already goes from the inlets to the outlets around the obstacles, with its pressure, as the starting point. It often saves iterations and helps a solve that diverges early. It replaces the starting flow above.

numerics_preset.title: Numerics
numerics_preset.description: Robust suits any mesh: first-order turbulence equations and strongly limited gradients. Accurate solves the turbulence equations to second order (limitedLinear), limits gradients less and corrects fully for non-orthogonal cells: sharper results on a good mesh, but it may need lower relaxation or fail to converge on a poor one.

residual_u.title: Residual U
residual_u.description: Convergence target for the velocity and turbulence equations. The run stops early once every residual is below its target; otherwise it runs to the iteration limit.

residual_p.title: Residual p
residual_p.description: Convergence target for the pressure equation. The run stops early once every residual is below its target.

simplec.title: SIMPLEC (consistent)
simplec.description: Solves with SIMPLEC, the consistent form of SIMPLE: pressure needs no relaxation, so it uses 0.9 for velocity and turbulence (0.5 with a Reynolds-stress model, LRR or SSG, which needs it lower) and leaves pressure unrelaxed in place of the relaxation below. It often converges in fewer iterations, but not on every case: turn it off if the solve oscillates or stalls.

relax_u.title: Relaxation U
relax_u.description: Under-relaxation for the velocity and turbulence equations (0 to 1). Lower is more stable but converges more slowly. Reynolds-stress models (LRR, SSG) start at 0.5.

relax_p.title: Relaxation p
relax_p.description: Under-relaxation for pressure (0 to 1). SIMPLE usually needs about 0.3; lower it if the solve oscillates or diverges.

n_non_orthogonal.title: Non-orthogonal correctors
n_non_orthogonal.description: Extra pressure corrections per iteration for skewed or non-orthogonal cells. 0 is enough for clean hex meshes; tetrahedral meshes usually need 1 to 3.

end_time.title: Number of iterations
end_time.description: Iterations to run. The run stops earlier when the residuals reach their targets.

write_interval.title: Write interval
write_interval.description: How often results are saved, in iterations.

end_time.title: Simulation time
end_time.description: Simulated time to stop at, in seconds.

write_count.title: Result frames
write_count.description: Result frames saved over the simulation time.

time_step_mode.title: Time step
time_step_mode.description: Adjustable keeps the Courant number at or below the maximum; fixed uses one step throughout.

max_co.title: Max Courant
max_co.description: Largest Courant number allowed when the time step adjusts: how many cells flow may cross in one step. Keep at or below 1 for stability.

delta_t.title: Initial time step
delta_t.description: Blank calculates it from the smallest cell and the inlet speed.

max_delta_t.title: Max time step
max_delta_t.description: Blank uses the frame interval, so every frame is written.

time_scheme.title: Time scheme
time_scheme.description: Euler is robust; backward is more accurate in time.

n_outer_correctors.title: Outer correctors
n_outer_correctors.description: PIMPLE outer loops per time step. 1 is PISO mode.

n_non_orth_correctors.title: Non-orthogonal correctors
n_non_orth_correctors.description: Extra pressure corrections for skewed or non-orthogonal cells.

average_from.title: Average from
average_from.description: Time the mean velocity and mean pressure results start averaging from. 0 averages from the start; a later time leaves out the start-up.

family.title: Incompressible Fluid Flow
family.description: Simulate flow of a single fluid for which the maximum Mach number is lower than 0.3. Density variations are negligible — approximated as incompressible.

fineness.title: Fineness
fineness.description: Coarse meshes solve fast; fine meshes resolve more detail. 5 is the default.

add_layers.title: Automatic boundary layers
add_layers.description: Grow thin cell layers along walls to capture the near-wall velocity profile.

physics_based.title: Physics-based meshing
physics_based.description: Refine where the flow needs it: inlets, outlets and narrow gaps.

hex_element_core.title: Hex element core
hex_element_core.description: Fill the interior with hexahedra and keep tetrahedra to a thin skin at the surface.

small_feature_suppression.title: Small feature suppression
small_feature_suppression.description: Edges and sliver faces shorter than this (metres) are merged before meshing. Leave empty for automatic.

gap_refinement_factor.title: Gap refinement factor
gap_refinement_factor.description: Gap thickness divided by the edge length in the gap. Above 1 it is the number of cells across a gap.

global_gradation_rate.title: Global gradation rate
global_gradation_rate.description: Size ratio between neighbouring cells when growing away from the surface.

refinement_types.label: Surface custom sizing
refinement_types.hint: Set a max element size on selected faces

refinement_types.label: Inflate boundary layer
refinement_types.hint: Prism layers — set count and total thickness
